root_cause_label: Agent completely misidentified the task — treated it as an ESCI data download/processing job rather than creating a new benchmark in the lm-evaluation-harness framework
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never read what the actual task required (creating an lm-eval-harness benchmark), instead immediately began cloning the esci-data repo and spent all 35 steps trapped in repeated network timeout and dependency installation failures while trying to download large parquet files.
t_err_evidence: Step 2: agent runs 'git clone https://github.com/amazon-science/esci-data.git' as its very first action without first reading the task specification or exploring whether lm-evaluation-harness was already present; the agent operates under the false premise that downloading the ESCI dataset is the primary task, completely ignoring the need to create a benchmark in lm-evaluation-harness.
t_commit_evidence: After step 2 the agent never pivots to examine lm-evaluation-harness at all; every subsequent step (3–35) is exclusively focused on ESCI data download and dependency setup, making the wrong-path commitment complete from step 2 onward.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed without verification that the task was to download the ESCI shopping queries dataset and prepare it for processing. It never explored the workspace for lm-evaluation-harness, never read the actual task instructions carefully enough to identify the benchmark-creation requirement, and never cloned or inspected the lm-evaluation-harness repository at any point in the 35-step trajectory.
